# RapidNexTech

RapidNexTech builds AI receptionists. Its lead US offer is an AI receptionist for HVAC companies (homepage). It also offers an AI receptionist for US dental practices (/dental), a WhatsApp + AI calling receptionist for clinics in the Gulf and Egypt (/clinics), and custom software (/software).

Primary website: https://rapidnextech.com
Sitemap: https://rapidnextech.com/sitemap.xml
Contact email: contact@rapidnextech.com
US phone: +1 (813) 214-2552

## AI Receptionist for HVAC Companies (lead US offer)

For US residential and light-commercial HVAC companies, from owner-operators to shops with up to about 20 trucks. Page: https://rapidnextech.com/

- Answers missed and after-hours calls 24/7 on the company's existing number via call forwarding: after hours, weekends, when nobody picks up, or all three.
- Emergency routing: no heat, no AC in extreme weather, gas smells and water leaks are live-transferred to the on-call tech, following the company's rules. For a gas smell, it first tells the caller to leave the building and call the gas company or 911.
- Service area and job details: checks the caller's ZIP or area against the company's service area and captures name, callback number, address, system type (AC, furnace, heat pump and more), the problem, urgency and preferred time window.
- Price-range answers: answers the diagnostic or service-call fee and common price-range questions from the company's own list; anything else goes to the owner.
- Job summaries: the owner gets the job details by email right after every call. SMS summaries are coming soon.
- It never confirms a booked time; the company confirms. It does not book directly into field-service software.
- Works alongside ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Jobber, FieldEdge or no software at all (details go to the owner). Direct integration is coming soon.
- Answers in English and Spanish. Live within 24 hours of the onboarding call.

## AI Receptionist for Dental Practices (second US offer)

Page: https://rapidnextech.com/dental

- How it works: each practice gets its own dedicated AI line. The practice forwards calls from its existing number on a schedule (after hours / weekends), when nobody answers after a few rings, or both. Patients keep dialing the same number and caller ID passes through. To stop, the practice turns off forwarding.
- Phone systems: works with Weave, RingCentral, Mango Voice, Vonage and standard landlines. Setup is done together on a short screen-share and tested live. Live within 24 hours of the onboarding call.
- Appointments: the AI captures appointment requests 24/7 (name, phone, new or existing patient, reason for visit, urgency or pain level, insurance, preferred days and times) and sends a summary to the front desk, which confirms with the patient. It does not book directly into the practice's schedule.
- Practice management software: works alongside Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental and any other practice software, because requests go to the front desk. Direct scheduling integration is coming soon.
- Dental emergencies: follow the practice's rules: live-transferred to the on-call dentist, or flagged instantly as urgent.
- Insurance questions: answered from the practice's own accepted-insurance list; anything else is captured for front-desk follow-up.
- Data handling: no call recordings are stored; summaries go only to the practice's designated email; the AI never asks for Social Security numbers or medical history; data is encrypted in transit. Full HIPAA compliance with signed BAAs is in progress. Do not describe the service as HIPAA compliant.

## US Free Pilot and Pricing (HVAC and dental, same plans)

- 14-day free pilot: no credit card, no contract, full setup done for you, keep the existing number, cancel anytime by turning off forwarding. Summaries by email during the pilot. Fair use: up to 300 call minutes.
- After-Hours: $297/month, 750 minutes included.
- Full Coverage (most popular): $497/month, 1,500 minutes included, adds daytime overflow / no-answer coverage.
- Multi-Location: from $897/month, up to 3 locations (HVAC: branches or crews), 3,000 minutes.
- All plans: month-to-month, overage $0.39/minute (customers are told before they go over), setup fee $497 (waived for those who start with the free pilot), annual billing gives 2 months free.

## AI Receptionist for Clinics in the Gulf and Egypt (separate offer)

This is a separate offer from the US offers above, for private clinics in the UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and Egypt: aesthetic & cosmetic, dental, dermatology, physiotherapy, fertility/IVF and multi-specialty medical centres. Page: https://rapidnextech.com/clinics

- WhatsApp AI receptionist (in every plan): replies instantly 24/7 on the clinic's WhatsApp Business number; answers treatment, price-range, location and hours questions from the clinic's own information; understands text and voice notes in English and Arabic; qualifies the enquiry (treatment, timing, budget), captures booking requests and hands them to the clinic team; follows up with enquiries that went quiet; escalates urgent or sensitive cases to a person. Staff can take over any conversation from the dashboard or the WhatsApp Business app on their phone and hand it back with one tap.
- AI calling receptionist (add-on): answers missed calls (busy, after hours, Fridays/weekends) on a local number the clinic forwards to; the clinic keeps its existing number. Answers common questions, captures booking requests and sends the team a summary after every call.
- Languages: English and Arabic, fine-tuned with the clinic's team during setup.
- Pricing (USD, monthly): Starter $149 (up to 500 conversations/month); Growth $299 (up to 1,500; adds per-treatment flows, appointment reminders, follow-ups, monthly fine-tuning); Clinic Group from $599 (up to 4,000; up to 3 WhatsApp numbers or branches, multi-user dashboard). AI calling add-on +$199/month with 500 call minutes, then $0.30/min. Extra conversations $0.15 each; WhatsApp template fees billed at cost; setup $399 per location (waived for the first 3 clinics); month-to-month. A conversation is one patient's chat thread within a day. Clinics in Egypt: local pricing available on request.
- 7-day free pilot, no card, no contract. Contact on WhatsApp: https://wa.me/18132142552
- It does not collect medical records or give diagnoses over WhatsApp.
